modern: If anyone should put to you the question of how the name Antoninus is spelt, would you strain your voice and shout out each letter? What then if they grow angry, will you be angry too? Will you not go on calmly and count out every letter? Just so, then, in this life too, remember that every duty is made up of certain parts. It is your duty to observe these, and without being disturbed or showing anger towards those who are angry with you, to go on your way and finish what is set before you.
original: If any man should propose to thee the question, how the name Antoninus is written, wouldst thou with a straining of the voice utter each letter? What then if they grow angry, wilt thou be angry too? Wilt thou not go on with composure and number every letter? Just so then in this life also remember that every duty is made up of certain parts. These it is thy duty to observe, and without being disturbed or showing anger towards those who are angry with thee, to go on thy way and finish that which is set before thee.
